utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the dues are still being sorted out—did they say when they’re due?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Not yet, but I’m expecting a clear notice soon. I’ll keep an eye on it and let you know as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Eli — I’d appreciate that. I’ll wait for the notice too and keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can take a quick look—what’s the amount and when’s it due?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s $25, and it’s due by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll take care of the $25 by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the club dues are due this week, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I think so — but I’d double-check the exact deadline and where to send it, just so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’ll double-check the deadline and payment details before sending anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the dues. I meant to ask if you’ve already handled them, or if you want me to walk over with you.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I haven’t handled them yet—if you don’t mind, walking over together would be great.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Of course, I don’t mind at all. Let’s head over together and get it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the exact dues amount and when it’s due? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before we do anything.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I’m sorry—I don’t have the exact dues amount on hand right now. I think it’s due soon, though, so I’d double-check the notice before paying.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, I’ll check the notice first so I don’t get the details wrong.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what’s the current plan for the dues?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — I’m collecting everyone’s dues by Friday, then I’ll pass them along to the club treasurer.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll send mine by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus—what’s the dues amount and when do you need it by?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It’s $20, and if you can bring it by Friday that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No problem, I’ll bring the $20 by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help with that—do you want me to check where the dues should be dropped off?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, please—if you could check where to drop them off, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll check where they’re collected and let you know the drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the dues are due pretty soon—want me to check the exact amount for you?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, that’d be great—thanks, Tess! If you find out, I’ll pass it along to the others right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear the exact amount.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Rey, are the club dues due this week? If so, how much is it this time?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I think they’re due this week. I’m pretty sure it’s the usual amount, but I’d want to double-check with the club treasurer.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — can you check with the treasurer and let me know? I’d like to pay it on time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll remind folks the dues are due soon and keep the plan simple.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll just pass that along if anyone asks.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, I’ll keep repeating that dues are due soon and leave it at that.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m just checking in on the club membership dues. If it’s easier, I can walk you through the amount and due date.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. That would help—I’m having a bit of trouble keeping track of things right now.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — the dues are due by Friday, and I can go over the amount with you now if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, about the dues — I heard they’re due soon, but I’m not sure if they changed the amount this month.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I haven’t heard about any change. Let’s check the notice together so we know the exact amount.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Good idea — let’s take a look at the notice so we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what are the club dues this time?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries—I'm checking the dues amount now, and I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, I’m here now—just let me know the amount when you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t checked the dues yet, but I can ask around and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I’d appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — I’ll ask around and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m pretty sure the dues are due soon—send me the amount and I’ll take care of it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure thing — the dues are $25, and I’ll leave the payment slip by the clubhouse.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—$25 works for me. I’ll grab the slip by the clubhouse and pay it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana — did you want to split the club dues or pay yours separately? I can help keep track either way.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let's split them, but can you double-check the total first? I want to make sure we have the right amount.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll double-check the total first, then we can split it evenly.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the club dues. I might’ve missed the update; how much is it this time?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s $20 this month — I can send you the payment details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara — please send the payment details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I heard the dues came up again—what’s the latest on them?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can check what’s changed, and if you need, I’ve got a calculator and a pen right here.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Gus—that’d be helpful. Let’s figure out what the dues are now.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Leo, I can help sort out the club dues if you want—just let me know what’s due and when.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — I’m not sure of the exact amount yet, but I’ll check and send it over.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No rush—send it when you have it, and I’ll help figure the rest out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just want to make sure we’ve got the dues amount and deadline right before I pay. Did the club say whether it’s cash only or if transfer is okay?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m not sure yet—let me check the club notice. I’ll confirm the dues amount, deadline, and whether transfer is okay.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, I’d appreciate that — I just want to avoid missing the deadline or bringing the wrong payment method.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, I just heard the club dues are due soon—want me to pass along the details to everyone?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, please pass them along—I’m keeping track of who’s paid, so that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word to everyone right away. If you want, I can also include the due date and payment method so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can check the school schedule and see when we can get those club dues sorted out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks Faye — I’d really appreciate that. I keep forgetting the right dates, so just let me know what you find.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll take a look tonight and tell you the best window once I’ve checked the school calendar.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell — I’ve got the dues info ready whenever you are. We can go over it together and make sure everything’s clear.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’d appreciate that. I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so I’m ready when you are.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — the dues are $20 for the season, and they help cover supplies and the clubhouse fund. If that’s a stretch right now, let me know and we can talk through options.
